Light Novel 'Tenkou-saki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi Datta Ken' Ends with 11th Volume
Yu Hibari's Tenkou-saki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi Datta Ken (Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her) light novel ended with its 11th volume on Friday. Hibari began penning the romantic comedy series, also known by its short title Tenbin, on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in June 2020. Kadokawa began publishing the title under its Sneaker Bunko imprint with illustrations by Shirakomiso (Saikyou Onmyouji no Isekai Tenseiki) in February 2021....
